# Test fixtures

## `sweep.mp3` (committed)

Drives `tests/soundscape.spec.js`. 6 s, mono, 44.1 kHz, 128 kbps — deliberately
synthetic so the spectrogram has structure that can be asserted on:

| Component | Appears as |
|---|---|
| Exponential sweep, 120 Hz → 8 kHz | a diagonal ridge |
| Steady 300 Hz tone | a horizontal ridge |
| 1.5 kHz bursts, 120 ms once a second | evenly spaced vertical spikes |

Generated by writing a 16-bit PCM WAV of that signal and encoding it with a
LAME port (macOS `afconvert` decodes MP3 but cannot encode it). It is committed
because the Soundscapes specs cannot run without it and it is small.

## `benchmark.tif` (NOT committed)

`tests/benchmark.spec.js` needs a real GeoTIFF and is gitignored (see
`.gitignore`), so **that spec fails on any clean checkout** — a missing fixture,
not a regression. Drop any GeoTIFF at `tests/testdata/benchmark.tif` to run it.
